 This endpoint allows users to retrieve all lightning strikes, in a streaming manner, that match the set criteria.

  - Space: Observations can be searched geographically by:
    - `radius` required parameters: `lat`, `lon` and `radius`
    - `boundingBox` required parameters: `minLat`, `minLon`, `maxLat` and `maxLon`
  - Time: To stream starting on a specified time:
    - For start time, provide `startTime` value. 
    - Data on the stream only last
